evals.name: new-bank-single-month
evals.prompt: Parse my March 2026 Neobank statement at skill/evals/fixtures/statements/nb_0326.pdf and create a new budget Excel for me.
evals.expected_output: Excel with a 2026-03 tab, Settings tab with default categories, hidden _parsers sheet containing the generated Python parser, all transactions categorized, no uncategorized rows.

assertions.name: parser_passes_ruff
assertions.description: Generated parser has no ruff lint errors

assertions.name: parser_passes_mypy
assertions.description: Generated parser passes strict mypy type checking

assertions.name: parser_self_test_passes
assertions.description: Parser --self-test passes against the input PDF

assertions.name: parser_has_required_structure
assertions.description: Parser defines Transaction and Statement dataclasses, parse_pdf function, and _self_test

assertions.name: excel_has_monthly_tab
assertions.description: Excel contains a 2026-03 monthly tab

assertions.name: excel_has_settings_tab
assertions.description: Excel contains a Settings tab with at least one category

assertions.name: excel_has_hidden_parser
assertions.description: Excel has a hidden _parsers sheet with Python source code

assertions.name: excel_all_transactions_categorized
assertions.description: Every transaction row in 2026-03 has a non-empty category

evals.name: joint-account-known-ground-truth
evals.prompt: I have a joint account PDF at skill/evals/fixtures/statements/joint_nb_0326.pdf — add it to my household budget Excel.
evals.expected_output: Excel with 2026-03 tab showing exactly 45 transactions, €1900.00 total income, €1011.44 total expenses, two account holders (THOMAS MÜLLER and JANE MÜLLER) captured in parser metadata.

assertions.name: parser_self_test_passes
assertions.description: Parser identifies joint account format and parses 45 transactions

assertions.name: excel_transaction_count_45
assertions.description: Monthly tab has exactly 45 transaction rows

assertions.name: excel_income_total_1900
assertions.description: Sum of positive amounts in 2026-03 equals €1900.00

assertions.name: excel_expense_total_1011_44
assertions.description: Sum of negative amounts in 2026-03 equals €1011.44

assertions.name: transactions_match_expected_json
assertions.description: First transaction is CafeNord -€4.19 on Mar 1; last is Transfer +€250 on Mar 28

assertions.name: excel_all_transactions_categorized
assertions.description: All 45 rows have a non-empty category

evals.name: deduplication-on-resubmit
evals.prompt: I already processed my Neobank statement last session. Here it is again: skill/evals/fixtures/statements/nb_0326.pdf. Update my budget Excel but don't add duplicate transactions.
evals.expected_output: Excel monthly tab has no duplicate rows. Skill reports 0 new transactions added (or skips gracefully). The existing parser is reused — no new parser generated.

assertions.name: no_duplicate_transaction_rows
assertions.description: Running the skill twice on the same PDF produces no duplicate rows in the monthly tab

assertions.name: parser_reused_not_regenerated
assertions.description: The _parsers sheet still has only one parser block for this bank (no duplicate blocks created)

evals.name: add-second-bank-to-existing-excel
evals.prompt: I already have a budget Excel with my Neobank data. Now I got a statement from another bank: skill/evals/fixtures/statements/ns_0326.pdf. Add it to my existing budget at skill/evals/fixtures/excel_states/after_march_nb/budget.xlsx.
evals.expected_output: Excel now has two parser blocks in _parsers (Neobank + new bank). March 2026 tab has more transactions than before. New parser passes ruff/mypy. No Neobank transactions duplicated.

assertions.name: two_parsers_stored
assertions.description: _parsers sheet now contains exactly 2 parser blocks (Neobank + new bank)

assertions.name: new_parser_passes_ruff
assertions.description: Newly generated parser has no ruff lint errors

assertions.name: new_parser_passes_mypy
assertions.description: Newly generated parser passes strict mypy

assertions.name: new_parser_self_test_passes
assertions.description: New parser --self-test passes against ns_0326.pdf

assertions.name: march_tab_has_more_transactions
assertions.description: 2026-03 tab has more than 45 rows (original Neobank count)

assertions.name: no_neobank_duplicates
assertions.description: The 45 original Neobank transactions are not duplicated

evals.name: add-new-month-to-existing-excel
evals.prompt: Here is my budget Excel with March already done: skill/evals/fixtures/excel_states/after_march_nb/budget.xlsx. I now have another statement from the same Neobank account: skill/evals/fixtures/statements/nb_0326.pdf. Add it — if it's a different month create a new tab, if it's already there skip duplicates.
evals.expected_output: If nb_0326.pdf is a different month: a new monthly tab is created, Neobank parser is reused (no new parser generated), _parsers still has 1 block. If same month: 0 new transactions added, no duplicates.

assertions.name: parser_reused_not_regenerated
assertions.description: _parsers still has exactly 1 parser block — existing Neobank parser was reused

assertions.name: no_duplicate_transactions
assertions.description: No transaction rows are duplicated across any monthly tab

assertions.name: excel_all_transactions_categorized
assertions.description: All transaction rows in all tabs have a non-empty category
